title: AGNC / AGNT / AGO / AGP — Regime, Liquidation, Book Value and Pair-Trade V9

notes: Raw Short -> actual Long corrections: AGNC 2020, AGO 2011 and AGO 2021.
AGO 2014 is a Long AGO / Short MBI pair trade. The source SQL performance row measures only the AGO long leg and must not be used as the pair return.
Source SQL performance rows are available for AGO 2005, 2008, 2009, 2011, 2014-long-leg and 2021.
AGNC 2020 is evaluated from its April 17 post-panic entry, not AGNC's full calendar-year 2020 return.
AGNC 2022 is an agency-MBS spread/duration/leverage short, not a mortgage-credit-default thesis.
Argonaut Technologies liquidation has a verified $0.70 first distribution, but final aggregate distributions after deregistration are not fully reconstructed.
AGO 2008 correctly identified Assured as the relative monoline survivor, but the absolute entry was too early and the 1Y source return was -54.5%.
AGO 2009's FSA strategic thesis was valid, but the author's ~$7.22 normalized operating EPS estimate was much higher than 2009-2011 actual operating EPS.
AGO 2021 nearly matched its 2023 GAAP BVPS and ABVPS forecasts, but the assumed 0.9x valuation multiple did not materialize.
Amerigroup was acquired by WellPoint for $92 cash/share in 2012 versus a late-2008 reference price around $29.5.

batch_lessons: The same agency-mREIT can be an excellent Long under Fed backstop and an excellent Short under tightening and MBS-spread widening.
Agency guarantees protect mortgage credit, not leveraged mREIT common book value.
Liquidation estimates must be reconciled to actual dated cash distributions; unverified residual distributions should not be treated as realized.
Financial-guaranty vintages should separate book-value growth, legacy claim resolution, capital return and market multiple.
Being the relative survivor in a crisis does not guarantee good absolute equity returns if the entry is too early.
Normalized insurer earnings should not be built by annualizing one unusually benign loss quarter.
Mortgage R&W recoveries can materially change insurer economics but may take years to rerate the stock.
Pair trades must be evaluated on the spread between both legs rather than the stored long-ticker performance row.
A forecast can nail book value and still miss the target price because the assumed P/B multiple is a separate hypothesis.
Policy-driven managed care can be countercyclical when recessions simultaneously increase eligible lives and state outsourcing incentives.
